info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Enterprise Services Procurement-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Enterprise Services Procurement API enables financial institutions to streamline the procurement process for banking enterprise services. It facilitates the submission of procurement requests, ensuring that organizations can efficiently manage their service acquisitions. Typical consumers of this API include banking administrators and procurement officers who require a structured way to handle service requests. This API provides essential functionality to enhance operational efficiency and supports the acquisition of vital banking services.

post.description: This endpoint allows clients to initiate procurement processes for various enterprise services. It requires specific parameters to create procurement requests efficiently.
